ns2:course.label: Social Justice in the Social Sciences
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary Grand Challenge Learning course in the Inequality and Cultural Understanding Pathway. Exploration of causes and solutions to inequality from a variety of viewpoints, such as sociology, economics, political science, and journalism. Includes experiential learning projects. Topics vary by section.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Inequality, Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
